display.name: Prometheus Node Exporter
display.description: Linux host health from Prometheus Node Exporter metrics ingested by SigNoz.

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') AS job FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'node_uname_info' AND job != '' GROUP BY job ORDER BY job

SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'service.instance.id') AS instance FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'node_uname_info' AND JSONExtractString(labels, 'service.name') IN $job AND instance != '' GROUP BY instance ORDER BY instance

display.name: CPU Usage
display.description: Non-idle CPU time averaged across cores for each selected instance.

filter.expression: service.name IN $job AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND mode = 'idle'

display.name: Memory Usage
display.description: Used memory calculated from MemAvailable and total memory.

filter.expression: service.name IN $job AND service.instance.id IN $instance
service.name IN $job AND service.instance.id IN $instance

display.name: Filesystem Usage
display.description: Used filesystem capacity by mountpoint. Pseudo and container filesystems are excluded.

filter.expression: service.name IN $job AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND device != '' AND fstype NOT IN ('tmpfs', 'devtmpfs', 'overlay', 'squashfs', 'proc', 'sysfs', 'cgroup', 'cgroup2')
service.name IN $job AND service.instance.id IN $instance AND device != '' AND fstype NOT IN ('tmpfs', 'devtmpfs', 'overlay', 'squashfs', 'proc', 'sysfs', 'cgroup', 'cgroup2')
